assets.imagegen_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Subtle section background texture
Primary request: Generate a new standalone off-white topographic paper texture for a premium finance website background. Very subtle gray contour lines, tiny elevation numerals, soft paper grain, clean rounded-corner page feel, sparse edges, no UI cards, no headline text, no buttons, no logos, no people. Aspect ratio 4:3.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate as a clean standalone rectangular image asset.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.postprocess_notes: Generated PNG was optimized with prepare_web_asset.py. Transparent engraving WebPs received a monochrome green-key decontamination pass after validation showed chroma halo residue.
